name: a point of light blooms into the opening headline
looks: In a near-black frame, a single faint point of light sits alone. It blooms outward and a two-line headline is already sharp around it, no letters dropping in one at a time, with its one round glyph picked out in a warm gradient. A soft tagline fades in beneath a beat later.
build: A radial bloom sprite scales up with a blur falloff in under 0.3s; the headline is one DOM block that resolves with a blur-to-sharp pass timed to the bloom's peak, not staggered per letter; the chosen glyph sits in its own span filled with the brand gradient and a soft glow; the tagline follows on its own short delay with a small y-slide. A corner HUD (mono label, timecode, scene counter) runs the whole film.
sound: A soft rising shimmer resolving into a quiet hit as the headline comes into focus, then quiet under the tagline.
prompt: Open a product film on a single point of soft light alone in near-dark. Let it bloom in well under a second into a short two-line promise, already in focus, with one glyph carrying the brand's gradient as a first sighting of the mark. Fade a one-line payoff in beneath a beat later.
